newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African noon stocks firm but off highs.
newsitem.headline: S.African noon stocks firm but off highs.

text.p: 1025 GMT - South African industrial shares were off morning highs but still firm on a stronger Wall Street overnight. Golds also off highs as players wary of upward movement in the gold price.
Dealers say market could rise from these levels as sentiment still positive on local long bonds.

Tigon up 20 cents to 14 rand after sharply higher results published earlier. Chicken producer Rainbow up six percent to 104 cents ahead of expected one third reduction in losses in year earnings which due next week.

Harwill falls 25 cents to 625 cents in heavy volumes boosted by an overnight foreign trade. PPC shares down 50 cents to 69 rand after posting poor results, confounding analysts who had expected a modest rise.
All-shares up 21.2 points to 7,212.6, industrials up 14.7 points to 8,578.1 and golds up 6.5 points to 1,212.2 points.
